purpose: Lightweight canonical memory for past and future Praxis experiment runs across local, cloud, and fresh Codex sessions.

cloud_state_policy.heavy_artifact_rule: Sync heavy outputs to S3 under experiments/<experiment_id>/, then commit a small report and registry pointer.
cloud_state_policy.negative_result_rule: Do not rescue negative results by threshold moving after reading outcomes.

experiments.name: TTA for Streaming APT Detection
experiments.best_evidence: Locked replay Macro-F1 0.8658, Recon F1 0.5050, PR-AUC 0.8738, override rate 4.7%; matched confidence-reject baseline kept Recon F1 at 0.0000; 2026-05-13 cloud paper-hardening audit passed 12/12 checks.
experiments.decision: Move to Praxis 06 venue conversion; keep DAPT2020 as appendix recipe evidence plus a negative TTA feasibility check.
experiments.next_cloud_action: No further cloud sweep needed for the locked claim. Use cloud only for venue-format builds, artifact packaging, or a preregistered external replication.

experiments.name: Praxis 04 - Stage-Conditional Routing
experiments.best_evidence: Treatment-Stage Macro-F1 0.5981 vs Baseline-TSE 0.6313, p-value 1.0000.
experiments.decision: Keep as bottleneck evidence that predicted stage routing under shift failed.
experiments.next_cloud_action: Do not run expensive full routing follow-up unless a new stage-prediction gate is defined first.

experiments.name: Stage-Conditioned Class Imbalance
experiments.best_evidence: Best Infilteration F1 gain only +0.0049; Benign F1 collapsed to 0.5481.
experiments.decision: Park simple weighting and resampling path.
experiments.next_cloud_action: Only reopen with a new calibrated rare-class rescue protocol or representation-learning gate.

experiments.name: Stage 1 Routing Recovery
experiments.best_evidence: Best macro policy 0.7723 +/- 0.0894; Recon improved but Data Exfiltration fell.
experiments.decision: Not clean enough for a standalone claim.
experiments.next_cloud_action: Promote a small report under reports/ before relying on this diagnostic in cloud.

experiments.name: Praxis 05 SAE for APT Interpretability
experiments.best_evidence: Full AWS Phase A failed feature-death 0.9119 and seed-stability 0.2815 gates.
experiments.decision: Do not proceed to Phase B; only one PIDSMaker or larger-hidden-state pivot is justified.
experiments.next_cloud_action: If reopened, start with activation export for a larger-hidden-state detector; do not relax Phase A gates.

experiments.name: SEC-LoRD / DS-LoRD
experiments.best_evidence: Old broad prompt seeding remains negative: strict audit 3B vanilla 0.276 vs seeded 0.090; 8B vanilla 0.466 vs seeded 0.284. 2026-05-17 Llama-3.1-8B relationship-evidence gate on the frozen 106-row evidence-addressable slice: vanilla 68/106 = 0.642, relationship evidence 97/106 = 0.915, broad seed 68/106 = 0.642; delta relationship minus vanilla +0.274; invalids 0 vs 0; evidence-only wins 33 vs vanilla-only 4.
experiments.decision: Promote only as a retrieval-conditioned CTI-MCQ task-compliance result. Do not treat it as a LoRD extraction claim; extraction remains a separate unrun experiment.
experiments.next_cloud_action: No rerun needed for this gate unless doing replication. Write the result narrowly; design any LoRD extraction experiment separately with its own gate.

experiments.name: Retrieval-Conditioned CTI Compliance
experiments.best_evidence: Locked 106-row no-label evidence-addressable CTI-MCQ slice. 8B gate: vanilla 68/106 = 0.642, relationship evidence 97/106 = 0.915, broad seed 68/106 = 0.642; lift +0.274; evidence-only wins 33 vs vanilla-only 4. Slice audit soft pass: complement vanilla 230/394 = 0.584. 3B cross-model gate: vanilla 0.547, relationship 0.887, broad seed 0.575; lift +0.340. 8B ablation: relationship 0.915, technique-only 0.764, random facts 0.566, empty evidence 0.670, vanilla 0.642.
experiments.decision: Package as a separate Praxis-style retrieval-conditioned CTI task-compliance experiment. Relationship evidence is the strongest tested condition, but the mechanism is mixed because technique-only evidence also helps. Do not claim LoRD extraction or pure relationship causality.
experiments.next_cloud_action: No additional cloud run needed for the current Praxis 07 claim. A first paper/chapter draft exists under paper/relationship_evidence_cti/; next work is editorial figure/example/TeX build polish unless an external-validity replication is pre-registered.

experiments.name: AI Supply Chain Backdoor Detection
experiments.best_evidence: Real LoRA traces: loss effect 0.0401, grad-norm -0.0673, update-norm 0.0203.
experiments.decision: Needs stronger poison construction and richer gradient diagnostics.
experiments.next_cloud_action: Improve poison construction and diagnostics before multi-seed cloud replication.

experiments.name: Contrastive SSL on Provenance Graphs
experiments.best_evidence: Positive > negative cosine rate only 0.5227.
experiments.decision: Do not spend GPU on GraphCL until node features or negatives improve.
experiments.next_cloud_action: Work on node features and negative sampling locally or in a small CPU gate first.

experiments.name: Continuous-Time TGN
experiments.best_evidence: Previous-event baseline Macro F1 0.6044 beat logistic temporal/hash features 0.5972.
experiments.decision: Reframe from next-event prediction to anomaly/window detection.
experiments.next_cloud_action: Do not start GPU TGN until anomaly/window labels or a stronger proxy target are defined.

experiments.name: APT Detector Watermarking
experiments.best_evidence: Macro-F1 dropped -0.0866; trigger signature accuracy stayed 0.2391.
experiments.decision: Redesign trigger objective or add owner-verification head before surrogate testing.
experiments.next_cloud_action: Run only a redesigned utility/signature gate, not surrogate extraction.

experiments.name: Membership Inference
experiments.best_evidence: Same-distribution shadow ROC-AUC 0.5599; temporal nonmembers 0.7256.
experiments.decision: Park as evidence that temporal shift drives apparent leakage.
experiments.next_cloud_action: Do not promote unless a stronger same-distribution signal appears under a frozen shadow protocol.

experiments.name: GNN TTP Graph Embeddings
experiments.best_evidence: SVD retrieval strong, but GraphSAGE top-5 0.060 vs SVD 0.926.
experiments.decision: Keep simple TTP-set result; do not pitch GNN yet.
experiments.next_cloud_action: Only reopen GNN with richer text/metadata features or a better graph objective.

experiments.name: Few-Shot APT Group Attribution
experiments.best_evidence: ATT&CK TTP-set SVD top-5 0.879 at 5 shots.
experiments.decision: Viable as ATT&CK profile retrieval, not CTI prose attribution without labels.
experiments.next_cloud_action: Build group-held-out TTP-set protocol; add document-to-group labels only if pursuing prose attribution.

experiments.name: LLM Threat Intelligence Fusion
experiments.best_evidence: Sources support retrieval/extraction, not early-warning outcome labels.
experiments.decision: Define outcome labels before model work.
experiments.next_cloud_action: Do not run an LLM model first; build a dated campaign/outcome evaluation set.

experiments.name: Concept Drift on Provenance Detectors
experiments.best_evidence: Full Cadets windows exist; weak density proxy chronological Macro-F1 up to 0.9788.
experiments.decision: Needs interval labels, confirmed benign windows, or another labeled stream for publishable drift claims.
experiments.next_cloud_action: Use density only as weak-proxy diagnostics until interval labels or confirmed benign windows exist.

experiments.name: Stage Routing on Provenance Graphs
experiments.best_evidence: Praxis 04 shows stage prediction bottleneck.
experiments.decision: Only reopen if graph stage labels or predictor beat the temporal split bottleneck.
experiments.next_cloud_action: Create a graph-stage-label gate before any supervised detector run.

experiments.name: Cross-Detector Adversarial Robustness
experiments.best_evidence: No stable detector suite yet.
experiments.decision: Wait for 2-4 trained detector families.
experiments.next_cloud_action: Do not launch until detector zoo has trained families with class support.

experiments.name: Causal GNN for Evasion Resistance
experiments.best_evidence: High-ceiling, no local gate yet.
experiments.decision: Keep as follow-on after 2+ publishable wins.
experiments.next_cloud_action: No cloud run until publication base and detector suite mature.

experiments.name: Reverse TTP Extraction
experiments.best_evidence: No public simulator or data.
experiments.decision: Revisit only after stronger publication base.
experiments.next_cloud_action: Do not run.

architecture_components.evidence: Local smoke converted 98862 Cadets edges to 20 windows; full E5 job processed 480537673 edge events to 9611 windows.
architecture_components.does_not_solve: Does not invent labels or confirmed benign support.

architecture_components.evidence: Four baseline families instantiate; detector gate blocked full Cadets because support was 9609 attack-touch vs 2 benign/unlabeled.
architecture_components.does_not_solve: No detector claim until class support is adequate.

required_after_cloud: sync heavy run outputs to S3
